label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_02
text: No need to stand there. Grab a seat.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_03
text: Here’s the Drayster take: The Academy Special’s\nthe best thing on the menu.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_04
text: It’s all so soft, you can basically just gulp it down.\nBarely even need to chew.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_select_01
text: Wow, that sounds tasty!

label: sdc02_0110_select_02
text: ...Chew your food, Drayton

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_05
text: Heh heh! You know what’s up.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_06
text: Heh heh! You and my ma would get along.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_07
text: So listen—your Pokémon are pretty strong, yeah?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_08
text: With a team like that, you’ve got a shot at\nbecoming the BB League Champion.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_09
text: Wouldn’t that be wild? An exchange student just\nrolling up here and snatching the crown?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_10
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I wanna see you join the BB League,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].\r\nYou in?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_select_03
text: Sure, I’ll—

label: sdc02_0110_select_04
text: I don’t kno—

label: sdc02_0110_mob_01
text: Whoa, it’s the Champion!

label: sdc02_0110_mob_02
text: And the rest of the Elite Four, too!

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_11
text: Look who’s decided to grace us with their\npresence.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_brother_01
text: ...What did you want to talk to me about?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_12
text: Nothing special. Just thought we could grab\na bite.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_13
text: Where better to do that than the cafeteria?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_brother_02
text: What a waste of time...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0110_brother_03
text: If you’ve got so much time to goof off, why don’t\nyou go train your Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0110_brother_04
text: You think maybe this is why you always lose\nto me?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_14
text: I’ll take that as a no.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_15
text: So I can’t swing a lunch date with you, even if\nI’ve got your ol’ pal with me?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_select_05
text: Long time no see!

label: sdc02_0110_select_06
text: You look different

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_16
text: You didn’t hear that [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she was coming to study\nabroad here?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_brother_07
text: For real?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_01
text: Yes, it’s true.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_02
text: Director Cyrano himself introduced h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer to me\nwhen we met at the school’s entrance.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_17
text: We’re already tight, us two.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_18
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]In fact, I was just asking
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
to
join
the
BB League![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_firebb_01
text: Ooh, I like it! That’d be fire![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0110_steelbb_01
text: A student from another school joining the\nBB League? Unprecedented.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_04
text: Th-that’s right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_05
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)] may be wonderfully
capable
in
battle,
but
that
doesn’t
mean
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she
belongs
in
the
BB League...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_19
text: Aw, c’mon. Do you all hate fun and friendship or\nsomething?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_20
text: You wanna exclude someone who’s taking our\nsame classes and living in our same dorms?\r\nHow’s [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she not one of us?![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_21
text: And isn’t this place supposed to be all about\nstudents having autonomy?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_22
text: I think we should vote on it.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_23
text: I’m a yes, obviously. How ’bout you, Lacey?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_06
text: I...I’m sorry, but considering the rules, it’s a no\nfrom me.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_07
text: What about you, Crispin?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0110_firebb_02
text: Huh? Yeah, why not![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_0110_firebb_03
text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s at our school. That makes h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer a student\nlike us, right?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_0110_firebb_04
text: How ’bout you, Amarys? Whaddya say?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_0110_steelbb_02
text: I abide by the rules of this institution. Proposition\ndeclined.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_24
text: Two against two, huh.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_25
text: All right, then! What says the reigning BB League\nChampion, our mighty Kieran?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_brother_10
text: It doesn’t matter who I’m facing...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0110_brother_11
text: I don’t lose.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_26
text: Heh. Guess we’ve got our answer.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_08
text: Ah! Kieran, wait—![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_09
text: Drayton! Manipulating people to get what you\nwant—it’s just not right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_28
text: Guess you’ll be joining the BB League, huh?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_29
text: Well, let’s look on the bright side! Maybe you\nand Kieran’ll come out of this better friends![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_30
text: Don’t worry, I’ll be right behind you. Every step\nof the way.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_31
text: But now that the decision’s been made, we better\nget you officially signed up.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_32
text: Meet me at the reception desk in the school’s\nentrance area![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_33
text: There you are! This is where we can get you\nsigned up for the BB League.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
